description: Asked whether every noise is a charge, and named the chain.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Reported well, and not at the table.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Still unwarned. Not in the house.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Reckoned the ale, answered Alse, and shifted her feet when the glass turned.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Set a pottage with a French name on the table, and asked after his wife.
name: Jacqueline Field

description: Gave the responses from his pew, short and cold, and did not speak to William.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Reached fourteenthly, on length of days.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Remembered as the man who looked up and did not ask.
name: Richard Field

description: Came in at four and left both things where they were.
name: William Shakespeare
